title: Support hierarchical alias schema (namespaced symbols + array [component] membership)
description:
sutra's alias vocabulary only supports a flat schema: AliasConfig.{component,file,symbol} are HashMap<String,String>, and find_alias does exact-term match. Real usage (kala-reverse, whose PRIMARY deliverable is a name->symbol map over a 28k-symbol decompiled binary) needs a richer schema that sutra currently rejects outright:

  [symbol]    "component/human_name" = "FUN_<hex>"    e.g. "positions/deg_to_rashi" = "FUN_008d1c50"
  [component] "name" = ["human_name", ...]            e.g. runtime = ["runtime/import_resolver"]

Today vocabulary::parse_aliases fails on the array-valued [component] section (serde type error: sequence where String expected), so the ENTIRE file is rejected and forward resolution is dead (see sutra/320 for the full diagnosis). This is option B from the sutra/320 decision — extend sutra to fit the model rather than force the user to flatten (option A), because flattening loses the component-grouping semantics that are the point of the map.

Scope:
1. Parse: accept string-OR-array for [component] (an ad-hoc membership set of symbol terms), keep [symbol]/[file] as-is. Likely a serde untagged enum or custom deserialize on the [component] value.
2. Storage: persist component membership (the "positions = [8 terms]" grouping) so a component-name query returns all member symbols. Decide: reuse the aliases table with a kind, or a new alias_membership table. NOTE this grouping is DISTINCT from sutra's existing clustering-derived components ([component] alias currently points a nickname at a real derived component) — reconcile the two meanings or namespace them.
3. Resolution: (a) resolve a component name -> all member symbols' locations; (b) resolve a namespaced [symbol] term by BOTH its full path ("positions/deg_to_rashi") AND its short segment ("deg_to_rashi"); define collision semantics when a short name is ambiguous across components (return all vs. disambiguate).
4. Migration/back-comfort: existing flat aliases.toml files must still parse unchanged.

Types-first gate applies: this changes AliasConfig's data model + adds a membership store + new resolution signatures. Draft the type skeleton (AliasConfig shape, membership storage, find/resolve signatures, collision + orphan semantics, error taxonomy) for review BEFORE implementation.

Verify against the real file at the end: vocabulary::parse_aliases(/home/josh/soft/kala-reverse/.sutra/aliases.toml) must succeed, and sutra_explore("deg_to_rashi") / ("positions") must resolve to symbols.

acceptance_criteria.text: vocabulary::parse_aliases succeeds on the real kala-reverse/.sutra/aliases.toml (array [component] + namespaced [symbol])
sutra_explore("deg_to_rashi") resolves to FUN_008d1c50 via short-name match
sutra_explore("positions") resolves to all member symbols of the positions component group
existing flat aliases.toml files parse and resolve unchanged (back-compat)
short-name collision semantics defined and tested

decisions.decision: Discriminate old vs new [component] meaning by TOML value type (string=nickname, array=group) rather than adding a separate [group] section
decisions.rationale: Matches how the real kala-reverse file is already authored and needs zero reconciliation ambiguity; a string is unambiguously a nickname, an array unambiguously a membership group.
decisions.rejected_alternative: A dedicated [group] TOML section — cleaner separation but diverges from the file Josh already wrote and adds a fourth section to document/migrate.

decisions.decision: Short-name collision resolves to ALL matching aliases (one ResolveMatch each)
decisions.rationale: resolve() already returns Vec<ResolveMatch>; returning all candidates maximizes discoverability in sutra_explore and avoids silent first-wins. Verified with two distinct */is_own_sign terms.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Require the full component/name path and error on bare ambiguous short names — safer but hurts the primary use (typing a bare human name).

implementation_plan:
1. vidhi-types-first: type skeleton for AliasConfig (string-or-array [component]), membership storage model, find_alias/resolve signatures + collision/orphan semantics, error taxonomy — reviewed before bodies.
2. Migration for membership storage (mirror existing singleton/marker patterns; reconcile with clustering-derived components meaning).
3. parse_aliases + AliasConfig deserialize; keep flat-schema back-compat.
4. sync_aliases writes membership; find_alias segment/short-name match; vocabulary::resolve component-name -> members and namespaced-symbol -> short+full.
5. Tests: real kala-reverse file parses; short-name and component-name resolution; ambiguous short-name collision; flat legacy file still works.
execution_record:
Implemented per the approved skeleton, no design deviations. Discriminator = TOML value type: string [component] value -> nickname (kind='component', legacy), array -> membership group (kind='group' + alias_group_member rows). Untagged ComponentValue enum (verified parsing under toml 0.8 before proposing). Namespaced [symbol] terms get a derived short_name column (trailing segment after '/'); resolve() tries exact term first, else find_aliases_by_short_name (short-name collision -> return ALL, one ResolveMatch each). Group resolves to union of member symbol locations. Migration 0062 rebuilds the aliases projection (short_name + 'group' in CHECK), adds alias_group_member, resets alias_sync marker to force one reprojection.

Verified end-to-end against a COPY of the real kala-reverse index.db (857MB, /home/josh/.sutra/kala-reverse) via a throwaway gated test (since the live server is the old binary): 49 alias terms projected; deg_to_rashi (short) -> FUN_008d1c50 @ 008d1c50.c non-orphan; positions/deg_to_rashi (full) -> FUN_008d1c50; positions group -> 6 member locations. Throwaway test removed after passing. 792 lib + 18 vocabulary integration tests green, clippy clean.

PENDING (not yet live): the running sutra MCP server is still the old binary (same pending install+restart step noted on sutra/320). This code is committed (7e25bab) on the current branch, unmerged/not redeployed. sutra_explore against the live kala-reverse workspace will only reflect the fix after install + server restart. Filing follow-up.
